role: Independent A first full-raster observations, partial before peer/author findings

findings.actualProblem: The legend defines all green arrows as food to consumer. Two green arrows from the oak tree to its own oak leaf and acorns instead connect an organism to its parts/products, which is no food-to-consumer relationship. The leaf-to-caterpillar, caterpillar-to-tit, acorn-to-mouse, consumers-to-owl and litter-to-decomposers paths are coherent.
findings.boundedCorrection: Remove the tree-to-leaf and tree-to-acorn arrowheads/feeding-style connectors, retain leaves/acorns as oak food sources. Alternatively clearly distinguish plant production arrows from feeding arrows without adding illegible small text.
